title: Show hit-error histogram
description: Timing histogram with UR, mean and early/late split, captured while the attempt was played. osu!catch has no timing and never shows it.

title: Show map
description: Title, artist, difficulty, mapper and star rating above the score.

title: Hold duration / s
description: Seconds the card stays up after the results screen opens. 0 keeps it up for as long as the results screen is open.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: Brand tag in the card header.
